title: Our story, what we do and the people who lead us
texts: Our story, what we do and the people who lead us
Who we are, how we work, and the HR policies that support you from your first day.

title: ABOUT FALCOR
texts: A family business serving UAE energy since 1979

Falcor is a family owned and managed company, established in Abu Dhabi in 1979 as a trading house serving the local Oil & Gas industry. Today we are a one-stop shop for Oil & Gas, Power and Utilities clients.

title: ABOUT FALCOR
texts: National oil companies, utilities and government entities. Their standards are contractual, audited and enforced.
A breach by one person is recorded against Falcor — not against the individual.
Contractor performance scores decide whether we are invited to the next tender. That is why a torn coverall, a phone out on site, or an argument at a gate is not a small thing here.
Where a client rule is stricter than ours, theirs applies. Where ours is stricter, ours applies.

title: HOW WE WORK · WORKPLACE
texts: Housekeeping is the cheapest signal of a well-run contractor — and the first thing a visiting client notices.
Clear it at the end of every day — no papers, no food, no cups
Wipe desk, keyboard and phone weekly; wipes are with Admin
Confidential paper goes to the shredder, never the bin
Wash your own cup and plate
Label your food — the fridge is cleared every Thursday at 4:00 PM
Wipe the counter and microwave; report a spill instead of leaving it
Washrooms: leave them as you would wish to find them
Meeting rooms: clear cups, papers and whiteboards
Prayer room and vehicles: returned tidy, every time
Food is eaten in the pantry — not at desks, not in meeting rooms, and never in a vehicle on client premises.
Smoke-free premises; use the designated smoking areas.
Bullying, harassment and racism lead to disciplinary action.
Report near misses, incidents or grievances immediately.

title: SAFETY · ADNOC & GOVERNMENT ENTITIES
texts: Complete the client's own induction before you mobilise, and carry your Falcor ID and site pass at all times.
No smoking, vaping, alcohol or controlled substances. Testing may happen at any time.
No photography, video or phone or camera phone use unless a written permit allows it. Assume it is prohibited.
No access outside your permit scope, however convenient the shortcut.
No removal of client material, scrap, equipment or documents — including scrap you believe has been thrown away.
Arrive early enough to be at the work front, in PPE, at start time. Gate queues are not an excuse the client accepts.
Follow designated routes, speed limits and parking.
No arguments with client staff or other contractors — ever. Escalate through your Falcor supervisor.
If you are not certain something is allowed, ask before you do it.
WHAT IS AT STAKE   One person's breach can cost Falcor a prequalification that took years to earn — and with it, the work that pays all of our salaries.

title: INTEGRITY · CONFIDENTIALITY
texts: Drawings, data, specifications and tender documents belong to the client.
Never copied to personal devices, personal email, messaging apps or cloud accounts.
Do not offer or accept cash, gifts, favours, entertainment or personal benefit — from anyone, in either direction.
That includes anything routed through a family member or a third party.
Report any approach to the CEO or the Director – Finance, Admin, HR & IT.
No posts, photos, videos or location tags from a client site or of client assets.
Do not present a personal opinion as a Falcor position.
Lost device or suspected phishing: tell IT the same day.
THE TEST   Unsure whether something is allowed? Ask before you do it. A confidentiality or bribery breach ends employment and can end Falcor's relationship with a client.

title: YOUR EMPLOYMENT · PROBATION
texts: Probation starts for all new hires and re-hires
Standard probation, as stated in your employment contract

Either party may end employment during the probation period in your contract, subject to applicable notice. Falcor gives at least 14 days' written notice; any termination is discussed in a formal review meeting and confirmed in writing.

Probation may be extended to a maximum total of six months, with Line Manager and HOD approval, confirmed in writing at least two weeks before it ends. Up to five days' approved unpaid leave extends probation by the same number of days.

Day 1: HR orientation and HSE induction. Weeks 1–4: agree SMART objectives with your Line Manager. End of probation: review meeting, outcome in writing; pro-rated annual leave and personal loans then become available.

title: YOUR EMPLOYMENT · LEAVE
texts: Return to work on the first working day after your approved leave ends.
Expecting a delay? Notify your Line Manager and HR Manager as soon as possible, with valid proof (e.g. medical certificate, flight cancellation).
In an emergency, an extension or a grace period of up to 5 days must be approved before your leave ends.
If Falcor recalls you early, extra costs such as fare differences are reimbursed against valid receipts.
IF YOU ARE LATE WITHOUT APPROVAL

Your air ticket benefit may be cancelled or recovered from salary, and you may be kept on unpaid leave if your role has been covered. A first offence brings a formal warning; repeated offences may lead to termination.

Leave beyond what was approved, unexplained absence or unjustified sick leave is recorded on your file, and all pay and benefits stop for that period. Persistent absence or lateness leads to progressive disciplinary action.
